objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, updated upon each new release.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document version is valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document version is valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable time period for validity checks, default is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The configurable time period for archiving before physical deletion, default is 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or areas of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data linked to this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity associated with the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language version of the document content.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and passes through all statuses of the main document's release process. Creation, modification, or archiving of an attachment triggers a new version of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle. It is released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, created without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, created by users with write access when a document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document and its attachments, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in DHC VISION in one or more roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for authorization assignment, distribution, and role-based access control (e.g. Reader group, Authors group, Reviewer group, Releaser group, Archive group, Business Admin group).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for distribution by email or for acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that manages the approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) including electronic signatures and email notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature applied by workflow participants to complete their tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (department, location) to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk entity that can be linked to documents in the system.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view filled by distribution group definitions, listing documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation providing filtered result lists based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The type of report (e.g. Status report: Documents & Instruction, Document monitoring, Status report for acknowledgement).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An active confirmation by a user that they have read and acknowledged a released document version, workflow-supported without signature.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created in DHC VISION with selection of corresponding document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format and displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_by_author
evts.description: The registered author signs the document creation in the first workflow step (Creator step).

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and/or formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers, completing the release workflow.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes are made, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled document) is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document, released directly without affecting the main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is deleted directly due to its lack of criticality.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a released document by any user with author rights, without affecting the document content or version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms additional validity, updating the Valid Until date by the default period.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a selected document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except the archive group, and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is re-validated, creating a new version with retained metadata and restored authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and user groups are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language, requiring its own review and release workflow.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version of a document is checked and released, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related read or write authorizations are assigned to a document via its properties.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are versioned and released with it.
A document can be supplemented with additional info objects that are not subject to its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within it.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to invalidate and archive it.
A request for reactivation references the invalidated document to be re-validated.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute or local extensions in multi-client systems.
One or more document templates can be defined per document type and selected when creating new documents.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to risks in the system.
Each document has a distribution list of user groups and persons for email notification and acknowledgement.
User groups are assigned to a document's distribution list for distribution and acknowledgement.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a document's distribution list.
Users are assigned to user groups which control their roles and authorizations in the system.
Users are assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, or releaser with corresponding personal authorizations.
